content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"This judge text resolves a Matthew 1:20 conflict by noting the challenger's DR3 chain answer and the defender's CR2/CR3 chain answers, so it is deciding a chain-against-chain collision under the rule.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"The phrase 'weighs chain against chain by footing' can be read to require an actual footing comparison, or only to permit a conclusion after identifying both chains without spelling out the comparison; I read the rule as requiring the former.","why":"The judge did not weigh the chains by footing; it treated the presence of an answer on each side as sufficient to make the link underdetermined."}
